inputs_sent.prompt: A locked-off wide shot of a bedroom at night. The camera is fixed and never moves. A phone glows mint on the bedside table. A man lies asleep in the bed and does not move. Very slowly and gradually, a double of him made of soft mint light sits up out of his sleeping body, half see-through at first, with a gentle glow inside its chest and hair-thin threads of light still joining it to the sleeper. The double looks down at the sleeper, moves to sit on the edge of the bed and gently pulls the duvet up over the sleeper's shoulder. Then it stands up at the foot of the bed, more solid now, and looks back at the sleeper with a calm, kind face, while the last fine threads of light stretch between them. The sleeper stays still. There are only two figures at all times: one solid and asleep, one made of light. The double never looks at the camera. Slow, graceful, deliberate motion with no sudden moves. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no music, no speech, no subtitles and no text.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, locked-off wide Static Shot of a dimly lit bedroom at night. The composition is centered on a man (S1) with dark hair and a beard, sleeping peacefully in a bed under a white duvet. On the wooden bedside table, a smartphone casts a soft mint-green glow across the sheets. In the background, a window with sheer curtains allows cool moonlight to filter into the room. The camera remains completely fixed throughout the scene. As S1 remains motionless in sleep, an ethereal double of him (S2) made of soft, translucent mint light begins to emerge from S1's physical form. S2 is initially semi-transparent, with a gentle pulse of light within its chest and fine, hair-thin threads of glowing light physically connecting the rising double to the sleeping man. S2 moves with slow, graceful deliberations, sitting up and looking down at S1 with a calm, kind expression. S2 then moves to the edge of the bed, reaching out with a luminous hand to gently pull the duvet up over S1's shoulder. By the end of the shot, S2 is standing at the foot of the bed, appearing more solid and vibrant, looking back at the sleeper while the last remaining threads of light stretch and thin between the two figures. S1 remains completely still and asleep.

overall_soundscape: The room is silent save for the faint, rhythmic and deep breathing of the sleeping man. A very subtle, crystalline hum emanates from the light double as it moves, accompanied by the soft, fabric rustle of the duvet as it is gently pulled up over the shoulder.
